mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (parking_log_id, mem_id, amount, pay_method, pay_date) VALUES (#{parkingLogId}, #{memId}, #{amount}, #{payMethod}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT pay_id AS payId, parking_log_id AS parkingLogId, mem_id AS memId, amount, pay_method AS payMethod, pay_date AS payDate FROM payment WHERE parking_log_id = #{parkingLogId} ORDER BY pay_date DESC LIMIT 1
